title: The Crooked Oath Again
author: Jude Galloway
blurb: Lena Amberdale, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
